explanations: task_default: use the task plugin default train distribution and eval protocol
curriculum compiler validates registry ids and lineage only; it does not optimize or rewrite schedules

experiment_memory.candidate_component_semantics: mechanism-delta-bound provider records use the sealed canonical delta plus runner activation; all other records use runtime identity difference

component_value_semantics.last_mean: last sampled weighted mean contribution; one snapshot is not evidence of inactivity or causal effect
component_value_semantics.max_abs: maximum absolute weighted contribution over bounded training samples

experiment_memory.purpose: bounded cross-round component/outcome index; consult it before proposing a candidate so previously evaluated mechanisms are not repeated blindly
experiment_memory.score_semantics: objective and guard values are copied from decision.comparison with their authoritative score-source identities; no score is recomputed
